title: Supabase Relational Database Schema & RLS Policies
description: Create PostgreSQL tables in Supabase for organizations, clients, invoices, invoice_items, expenses, categories, and payments with Row Level Security (RLS).
acceptanceCriteria: Tables created: organizations, clients, invoices, invoice_items, expenses, categories, payments
Row Level Security (RLS) enabled on all tables
Multi-tenant isolation policies created using auth.uid() and organization_id
Indexes created on organization_id and status fields

steps.description: Create DDL migration schema for core financial tables
steps.details: Define SQL schema with UUID primary keys, foreign keys with ON DELETE CASCADE, and timestamps.
Create RLS policies ensuring users can only read, insert, update, and delete rows belonging to their active organizationId.
